title: Crux release manifest
description: PROVISIONAL: a first shape, not frozen before a product's first real release. What a product's release bundle records about one build, as hashes and identities only. Fields that only one product needs go in the optional extensions object. scripts/check-release-bundle.py applies the subset of keywords used here: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, pattern, minimum, const, enum and items.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema. A change that an older checker would misread raises it.

identity_algorithm.description: The algorithm that gave firmware_identity. It is the name that scripts/record-build-provenance.py records.

product_version.description: A SemVer 2.0 version. Pre-release and build metadata, such as +7, are allowed and not required.

release_tag.description: The tag of the product repository that this bundle was built from.

sdk_version.description: The version of the Zephyr SDK that built the image.

build_image.description: The container or runner image that built the image, as a name, tag or digest, never a path.

target.description: The Zephyr board target. There is no default.

bundle_hashes.description: The SHA-256 of every bundle item except the manifest itself, by path inside the bundle.

image_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the firmware image. The image is not in the bundle.

firmware_identity.description: The SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the identity record that identity_algorithm defines.

vendor_deliveries.description: Per vendor project, its delivery tag and the hash of its hash list.

replaced_modules.description: Each module that the product replaced under a new name.

extensions.description: Fields that one product needs and the platform does not, such as a security counter. The platform checker does not look inside, except for paths and private strings, like any other part of the manifest.
